Header: Thandu matrum ver thulaipan Plocaederus ferrugineus

Prevention: Swabbing the trunk with neem oil 5% for three times in a year. (Jan- Feb, May - June, Sep-Oct)
Swabbing the trunk with coaltar once in a year
Uproot and destory the completely damaged trees.
Monitoring: Monitoring the gummosis (oozing of gumlike substance) at the base of the tree.
Presence of chewed up material or excreta at the base of the tree.
Observe for the presence of eggs (resembling rice grains) on and underneath the bark
Direct Control: Metarhizium anisopliae suspension on the excreta protruding outside the bore hole.
Drenching the ground around the affected plant with chlorpyriphos 0.2% (2ml per litre of water)
Restrictions: Repeated drenching shall be avoided to reduce residue accumulation in the soil.
II (moderately hazardous ), organophosphate, non systemic insecticide with contact, stomach and respiratory action.
